article_content: Chris Brown has transitioned to outpatient care while maintaining court-ordered rehabilitation commitments, according to spokesperson Nicole Perna. The artist began intensive treatment on October 28, 2023, following his release from custody in Washington D.C. related to misdemeanor assault charges. Perna stated: 'He remains dedicated to self-reflection and behavioral improvement to advance his personal and professional growth.' Brown continues fulfilling 1,000 hours of court-mandated community service in Los Angeles as part of his 2009 felony domestic violence conviction involving singer Rihanna. Recent legal complications arose from an October altercation near the White House that resulted in assault charges. These developments jeopardize his probation status, originally imposed after the high-profile attack preceding the Grammy Awards. California authorities maintain strict oversight, with prosecutors awaiting a probation officer's report ahead of November 20 court proceedings. Legal experts suggest Brown's rehabilitation efforts might influence judicial decisions regarding potential probation violations. The artist faces possible four-year imprisonment if found non-compliant with court stipulations.

article_content: Chicago (CNN) -- Protesters and police clashed outside the NATO summit in Chicago as world leaders discussed Afghanistan's future. CNN affiliate WLS footage showed officers using batons against protesters pushing police lines. The violence followed earlier peaceful demonstrations. Chicago Police reported 45 arrests and four officers hospitalized, including one stabbed. Superintendent Garry McCarthy stated: 'They charged the cops and assaulted officers. Responsibility lies with those who attacked police.' Occupy Chicago reported injuries among demonstrators, tweeting: 'Medics needed for detained protesters. Bloodied individuals being moved.' A city official told CNN 75-100 protesters refused dispersal orders, throwing objects at police. McCarthy praised officers' performance, alleging some protesters used red paint to fake injuries. Near the summit venue, President Obama met with Afghan President Karzai, emphasizing continued efforts before NATO's 2014 withdrawal: 'Challenges remain, but we're on track with global support.' NATO leaders planned Afghanistan transition timelines while addressing defense budget constraints through 'smart defense' initiatives like shared drone purchases. Security intensified after three alleged anarchists were arrested pre-summit for plotting attacks. Police confirmed no imminent threats to attending leaders. The summit formalized plans transferring security responsibility to Afghan forces by 2014, with potential post-withdrawal training missions. Controversies included Pakistan's blockade of NATO supply routes since a November 2011 airstrike. U.S.-Pakistan negotiations continued during the summit. French President Francois Hollande announced early troop withdrawal, drawing Taliban approval. Republican candidate Mitt Romney criticized NATO members' defense spending in a Chicago Tribune op-ed.

Nadintendent Garry McCarthy oświadczył: 'Rzucili się na policjantów i zaatakowali funkcjonariuszy. Odpowiedzialność spoczywa na tych, którzy zaatakowali policję.' Przywódcy NATO ustalili harmonogram przejęcia odpowiedzialności przez Afganistan, wprowadzając inicjatywy 'inteligentnej obrony' jak wspólny zakup bezzałogowców. Bezpieczeństwo wzmocniono po aresztowaniu trzech domniemanych anarchistów oskarżonych o planowanie ataków przed szczytem. Policja potwierdziła brak bezpośrednich zagrożeń dla uczestników. Szczyt sformalizował plany przekazania odpowiedzialności afgańskim siłom do 2014 roku, z możliwością misji szkoleniowych po wycofaniu wojsk. Kontrowersje obejmowały blokadę pakistańskich tras zaopatrzeniowych NATO po incydencie z listopada 2011 roku. Negocjacje USA-Pakistan trwały podczas szczytu. Francuski prezydent Francois Hollande ogłosił wcześniejsze wycofanie wojsk, co spotkało się z aprobatą Talibów. Kandydat republikanów Mitt Romney skrytykował wydatki obronne członków NATO w artykule dla Chicago Tribune.

article_content: The Tamil action-thriller 'Leo,' starring Thalapathy Vijay, debuted with ₹64 crore but has shown declining box office returns. Released on October 19, the film earned between ₹2.15 crore and ₹4.25 crore daily in its second week. After collecting ₹2.15 crore on Friday, it grossed ₹4 crore on Saturday, reaching a total of ₹323 crore. The film achieved 29.22% occupancy rate in Tamil-language screenings on Saturday. Directed by Lokesh Kanagaraj, 'Leo' marks Vijay's second collaboration with the director after 'Master.' The cast includes Sanjay Dutt, Trisha Krishnan, and Arjun Sarja. As the third installment in the Lokesh Cinematic Universe (LCU), it follows 2019's 'Kaithi' and 2022's 'Vikram.' Production company Ahimsa Entertainment announced on November 2, 2023, via Twitter that 'Leo' surpassed ₹40 crore in UK/Europe markets, stating: 'The world isn't just watching; it's celebrating Thalapathy overseas!' The film has outperformed Prabhas' 'Adipurush' in India and now aims to surpass Rajinikanth's 'Jailer,' which earned ₹348.55 crore domestically and ₹604 crore worldwide. At a Chennai success event, Vijay told fans: 'You are kings, and I am your Thalapathy. I exist to fulfill your wishes.'

article_content: An Ethiopian military transport aircraft crashed during landing at Mogadishu's international airport early Friday morning, resulting in four fatalities among crew members, according to African Union peacekeeping officials. The AMISOM coalition reported the cargo plane, which was delivering military supplies to peacekeeping forces, burst into flames immediately upon crashing at approximately 7:50 a.m. local time. Airport personnel confirmed the aircraft's mission involved resupplying AU troops engaged in Somalia's stabilization efforts. The African Union peacekeeping mission, operational since 2007 with over 17,000 personnel from across Africa, issued formal condolences to Ethiopia. The UN-supported initiative aims to assist Somalia's government in maintaining security amid ongoing conflicts with Islamist groups, continuing the country's recovery from more than two decades of conflict.

Według misji AMISOM, maszyna transportująca zaopatrzenie wojskowe dla sił pokojowych stanęła w płomieniach zaraz po uderzeniu w pas startowy około godziny 7:50 czasu lokalnego. Pracownicy lotniska potwierdzili, że samolot realizował misję zaopatrzeniową dla afrykańskich sił pokojowych zaangażowanych w stabilizację Somalii. Licząca ponad 17 tysięcy żołnierzy misja UA, działająca od 2007 roku z udziałem państw całego kontynentu, złożyła oficjalne kondolencje Etiopii. article_content: A NASA-funded study warns that global industrial civilization could collapse within decades due to wealth inequality and unsustainable resource use. The research supported by Goddard Space Flight Center identifies population growth, climate change, water scarcity, agricultural pressures, and energy demands as key destabilizing factors. According to The Guardian's report, mathematician Safa Motesharrei's team found that concentrated wealth among elites and technological overconsumption create systemic risks. The study cites historical examples including the Roman, Han, Gupta, and Mesopotamian empires as evidence of advanced societies' vulnerability. Two collapse scenarios are outlined: one where worker shortages from commoner famine trigger breakdown, and another where elites temporarily persist after majority collapse. Researchers emphasize reducing inequality and managing population growth as crucial prevention measures.

Analiza wspierana przez ośrodek Goddard Space Flight Center wskazuje wzrost populacji, zmiany klimatyczne, niedobory wody, presję na rolnictwo i zapotrzebowanie energetyczne jako główne czynniki ryzyka. Według raportu The Guardian, zespół matematyka Safy Motesharrei udowodnił, że skoncentrowane bogactwo elit oraz nadmierna eksploatacja technologiczna generują systemowe zagrożenia. Jako historyczne przykłady wrażliwości rozwiniętych społeczeństw badanie wymienia imperia rzymskie, han, gupta i mezopotamskie. Opisano dwa scenariusze: pierwszy z załamaniem się społeczeństwa przez brak pracowników w wyniku głodu zwykłych obywateli, drugi z przejściowym przetrwaniem elit po upadku większości. Naukowcy podkreślają, że redukcja nierówności i kontrola przyrostu ludności to kluczowe środki zapobiegawcze.

article_content: A violent incident occurred at a Ladbrokes betting shop on Sunday morning when a customer assaulted a cashier after losing a £1.20 wager. Security footage captured the 10:10am attack, showing the man in a green T-shirt punching the employee twice across an unprotected counter before exiting. Police used the CCTV evidence to arrest a 29-year-old suspect. The victim sustained facial bruising and swelling. Ladbrokes confirmed cooperation with authorities and stated shops without protective screens typically have fewer security incidents. The company revealed the disputed bet's potential payout was just £1.20.

article_content: Imtiaz Shah received a 30-month prison sentence and three-year driving ban after causing a catastrophic collision while driving with untreated sleep apnea. The 42-year-old from Nelson, Lancashire, ignored medical advice against driving and crashed into motorcyclist Steven Hayes at a Blackburn roundabout in April 2023. Hayes, 48, suffered permanent paralysis and brain injuries requiring full-time care. Preston Crown Court heard Shah's Honda CRV veered across lanes before the head-on impact that threw Hayes 'like a rag doll,' leaving biological material on Shah's windshield. Hayes' daughter Jenny condemned the sentence: 'He'll be free in 15 months while my dad serves a life sentence of disability.' Medical reports confirmed Shah had driven 200 miles on the collision day despite his sleep disorder diagnosis.

Sąd w Preston usłyszał, że Honda CRV Shaha najpierw zjechała z pasa ruchu, a następnie uderzyła w Hayesa z siłą, która wyrzuciła go 'jak szmacianą lalkę', pozostawiając ślady biologiczne na szybie. Córka poszkodowanego, Jenny, skomentowała wyrok: 'Wyjdzie za półtora roku, podczas gdy tata już zawsze będzie potrzebował pomocy'. Dokumentacja medyczna potwierdziła, że Shah przejechał 200 mil w dniu wypadku mimo zdiagnozowanych zaburzeń snu.

article_content: SaaS startup OSlash, backed by $5 million in March 2022 funding from investors including Cred founder Kunal Shah and Notion's Akshay Kothari, will wind down operations by November 30, 2023. Co-founders Shoaib Khan and Ankit Pansari announced the closure in a blog post, citing unsuccessful attempts to achieve product-market fit despite pivoting from their initial OSlash Shortcuts to AI-powered text expansion tools. The Bengaluru- and San Francisco-based company, which raised $2.5 million from Accel Partners in September 2021, will release an open-source extension for existing users to export data until November 29. All user information will be permanently deleted upon final shutdown. OSlash's closure halts 2022 expansion plans that included US/European hiring and development of cross-application search features.

Założyciele Shoaib Khan i Ankit Pansari poinformowali o decyzji na firmowym blogu, wskazując na brak osiągnięcia produktowo-rynkowej fit pomimo zmian strategii - od początkowych OSlash Shortcuts po narzędzia do automatycznego rozszerzania tekstu oparte na AI. Firma z siedzibami w Bengaluru i San Francisco, która wcześniej pozyskała 2,5 mln dolarów od Accel Partners we wrześniu 2021 r., udostępni użytkownikom otwartoźródłowe rozszerzenie do eksportu danych do 29 listopada. Wszystkie dane zostaną trwale usunięte po ostatecznym zamknięciu. Decyzja wstrzymuje plany ekspansji z 2022 r., w tym rekrutację w USA i Europie oraz rozwój narzędzi wyszukiwania między aplikacjami.

article_content: Against modern animation trends, the hand-drawn sequel 'The Snowman and the Snowdog' became Channel 4's top 2012 Christmas program. The December 24 broadcast drew 5.8 million peak viewers, the channel's highest holiday ratings in 10+ years. Competing against BBC1's 'Merlin' finale (8.15pm start) and ITV's 'Coronation Street' (8 million viewers), the £2 million production required 77 artists using 200,000 paper sheets and 5,000 pencils. Each animated second took 30 hours, with weekly progress limited to 5 seconds. Original author Raymond Briggs, 78, initially resisted the sequel but approved the final product: 'It's not vulgar and American. I found nothing to grumble about.' The 1978 adaptation concurrently drew 2.8 million viewers - its largest audience since 1999.

Produkcja o budżecie 2 milionów funtów konkurowała z finałowym odcinkiem 'Merlina' na BBC1 oraz 'Coronation Street' na ITV1, który przyciągnął 8 milionów widzów. 77 artystów zużyło 200 tysięcy kartek papieru i 5 tysięcy ołówków podczas rocznej produkcji. Każda sekunda animacji wymagała do 30 godzin pracy. Raymond Briggs, autor oryginalnej książki, początkowo niechętny kontynuacji, pochwalił efekt: 'Nie ma tu przesady typowej dla amerykańskich produkcji. Nie mam żadnych zastrzeżeń.' Pierwsza ekranizacja z 1978 roku również odnotowała rekordową oglądalność od 1999 roku - 2.8 miliona widzów.

article_content: In an upscale Atlanta medical practice, Dr. James Braude and colleagues confront a surge in uninsured patients following job losses. Their response combines free care with an innovative mutual aid system where insured patients voluntarily support treatment costs for others. 'Helping people isn't just our job - it's our professional identity. Failing to assist feels like personal failure,' Braude states. This local scenario mirrors national debates as President Obama's healthcare initiative aims to cover 50 million uninsured Americans. The proposed overhaul would mark the administration's most significant domestic policy effort, though key implementation details remain undefined. While promising comprehensive coverage, the plan faces scrutiny over projected costs exceeding $1 trillion per decade and disputes about introducing government-backed insurance alternatives. Political divisions run deep. Democrats debate funding approaches, while Republicans like House Leader John Boehner push for modifying current systems rather than creating new bureaucracies. Economic pressures intensify as healthcare consumes 17% of GDP, with forecasts predicting 33% by 2050 without systemic changes. Industry influence persists as a major factor. Health sector entities have invested $660 million in lobbying since 2013. Public skepticism endures, with recent polls showing only 20% expect family benefits from reforms. Despite obstacles, frontline providers like Braude remain hopeful, cautioning that maintaining the status quo leaves millions 'one major health crisis away from bankruptcy'.

'Pomoc to nie tylko nasz zawod - to czesc naszej tozsamosci. Niemoznosc pomocy odczuwamy jak porazke,' tlumaczy Braude. Ta lokalna sytuacja odzwierciedla krajowa debate nad planem Obamy, ktory ma objac ubezpieczeniem 50 milionow Amerykanow. Propozycja stanowi najambitniejsza inicjatywe wewnetrzna obecnej administracji, choc kluczowe szczegoly realizacji wciaz nie sa okreslone. Podzialy polityczne sa glebokie. Demokraci dyskutuja o metodach finansowania, podczas gdy republikanie, jak lider Izby John Boehner, opowiadaja sie za usprawnieniem istniejacych systemow. Sektor zdrowotny wydal 660 milionow dolarow na lobbing od 2013 roku. Sondaze wskazuja, ze jedynie 20% spoleczenstwa spodziewa sie korzysci dla swoich rodzin. article_content: In a surprising courtroom development, former Massachusetts Governor Michael Dukakis appeared as a defense witness for Robel Phillipos, a college friend of convicted Boston Marathon bomber Dzhokhar Tsarnaev. Testifying in federal court, Dukakis recounted his April 2013 phone conversation with Phillipos five days after the deadly attack that killed three and injured over 260. The 80-year-old politician described his decades-long family friendship with Phillipos, revealing he'd known the defendant since childhood. 'We've watched him grow up,' Dukakis stated, noting he'd even taken a 10-year-old Phillipos to the 2004 Democratic National Convention. Phillipos reportedly became emotional during this testimony, wiping away tears. Prosecutors allege Phillipos lied about his presence in Tsarnaev's dorm room when critical evidence - including fireworks emptied of explosive powder - was removed hours after the FBI released photos identifying the Tsarnaev brothers as suspects. Defense attorneys counter that the then-19-year-old was overwhelmed during marathon FBI interrogations and impaired by marijuana use. Dukakis testified that Phillipos sounded 'confused' during their April 20, 2013 call. 'He didn't know what he'd told investigators after five hours of questioning,' the former governor recalled. When pressed by prosecutors, Dukakis acknowledged lacking direct knowledge of Phillipos' FBI statements but maintained his testimony addressed the defendant's state of mind. Two other individuals present during the dorm room evidence removal have already been convicted on conspiracy and obstruction charges. The trial continues as jurors weigh whether Phillipos intentionally misled investigators or acted under duress and impairment.

Dukakis opisał swoją kwietniową rozmowę telefoniczną z 2013 roku, która odbyła się pięć dni po zamachu podczas maratonu, w wyniku którego zginęły 3 osoby, a ponad 260 zostało rannych. 80-letni polityk podkreślił wieloletnią znajomość z rodziną Philliposa, znając oskarżonego od wczesnego dzieciństwa. Prokuratura zarzuca, że Phillipos okłamał śledczych dotycząco swojej obecności w pokoju dormitorium Carnajewa, gdzie usunięto kluczowe dowody – w tym petardy pozbawione prochu – kilka godzin po tym, jak FBI opublikowało zdjęcia braci Carnajew jako podejrzanych. article_content: Hotel tariffs and airfares in Ahmedabad have skyrocketed ahead of Sunday's Cricket World Cup final between India and Australia, compelling fans to either pay exorbitant rates or revise their travel arrangements. A Mumbai-based CEO revealed he's driving 500+ km to attend after securing a ₹65,000 match ticket, citing unavailable accommodations and inflated prices. The ITC Narmada Hotel, hosting the Indian team, listed rooms at ₹4 lakh plus ₹72,000 taxes for Sunday night - a 3,536% increase from its November 21 rate of ₹11,000 plus ₹1,980 taxes. Airlines similarly raised fares, with one Delhi-based hotel executive paying ₹40,000 per person for a one-way flight. Overflow demand has extended to nearby cities, with Vadodara's Welcomhotel ITC charging ₹30,000/night and Udaipur-Mumbai flights fully booked until November 24. Lemon Tree Hotels reported complete sell-outs, while Wakefit offered free overnight stays at its Gandhinagar store for ticket holders. Despite these measures, some fans canceled plans, with one executive stating, 'Paying ₹3 lakh for tickets alone isn't sensible when we can watch comfortably at home.'

article_content: Austin, Texas (CNN) -- Podcasting revitalized Kevin Smith's career. The filmmaker emphasized this during a South by Southwest panel titled 'The Business of Kevin Smith.' Smith, renowned for his 1994 indie breakthrough 'Clerks,' revealed podcasting became his creative focus after losing enthusiasm for traditional filmmaking during 'Zach and Miri Make a Porno.' 'Podcasting gave me the financial freedom to step away from Hollywood,' Smith stated. He co-created 'SModcast' with Scott Mosier in 2007, initially offering free content before implementing merchandise sales, sponsorships (including adult product Fleshlight), and a premium ad-free version. Their podcast network now features multiple programs and sold-out live events. Smith's digital roots trace back to a 1990s 'Clerks' fan site developed by Ming Chen, later hired to manage View Askew Productions' official site. The platform amassed over 200,000 users, establishing Smith as an early adopter of online fan engagement. He recalled: 'Among filmmakers then, only Peter Jackson and I had significant web presences.'

article_content: Health service leaders are considering unprecedented measures to address funding shortfalls, including potential nightly charges of £75 for hospital accommodations - an unofficial figure suggested by unnamed sources. NHS Confederation CEO Rob Webster warned that without adequate financial support matching growing demand, difficult decisions about service priorities may become unavoidable. While officials confirm no formal proposals exist, discussions highlight tensions between maintaining universal healthcare and addressing systemic underfunding. The Department of Health reiterated its commitment to free-at-point-of-use services despite warnings from medical organizations about unsustainable pressures. Current budget increases of £12.7billion over this parliament period fail to keep pace with inflation (resulting in <0.1% annual real-terms growth) and demographic changes, with projections indicating a £30billion deficit by 2020. Historical data reveals persistent financial challenges since the NHS's 1948 founding, exacerbated by rising treatment costs and complex population health needs. Controversial suggestions from former health minister Lord Warner propose monthly NHS usage fees, while nursing groups debated but ultimately rejected charges for missed GP appointments. Despite employing over 700,000 staff and serving millions annually, healthcare leaders argue current funding models require urgent reform to preserve core principles of equitable access based on need rather than payment ability.

Historyczne dane pokazują permanentne wyzwania finansowe od powstania NHS w 1948 r., pogłębione przez rosnące koszty leczenia i złożone potrzeby zdrowotne społeczeństwa. article_content: (CNN) -- While 'Englishization' isn't found in dictionaries, Google searches reveal discussions about Japan's cultural shifts. Hiroshi Mikitani, CEO of Rakuten Inc., embraces the term during our conversation about Japan's future. Leading Japan's largest e-commerce platform with 6,000 employees and $3 billion annual sales, Mikitani aims to make Rakuten a household name like Google within a decade through English adoption. Mikitani states: 'English is the global business language. For Japanese service companies to succeed worldwide, this transition is essential.' By 2012, Rakuten plans to mandate English for all internal communications—a significant challenge given Japan's 2010 TOEFL rankings placing it second-lowest in East Asia, above only Laos. Honda CEO Takanobu Ito publicly opposed the strategy: 'It's impractical for Japanese companies to use only English domestically.' Mikitani counters that Rakuten's internet services differ from Honda's manufacturing: 'Global success requires internationalizing headquarters.' Despite Japan's economic challenges, Rakuten expands globally with new ventures in China and acquisitions in the U.S. and France. Mikitani argues: 'National boundaries and currencies will matter less in global competition.' He criticizes Japan's aging leadership and risk-averse youth: 'Young people prioritize stability over ambition. We need dynamic, outward-looking policies.' While acknowledging Japan's lag in innovation implementation, Mikitani remains optimistic: 'Our window for change isn't endless, but Rakuten—meaning optimism—shows a path forward through IT and economic restructuring.'

Kierując największą japońską platformą e-commerce z 6 tys. pracowników i obrotem 3 mld dolarów rocznie, Mikitani chce, by Rakuten stał się rozpoznawalny jak Google w ciągu dekady dzięki przejściu na angielski. Mikitani deklaruje: 'Angielski to globalny język biznesu. Dla japońskich firm usługowych to jedyna droga do międzynarodowego sukcesu.' Do 2012 roku Rakuten wprowadzi angielski jako obowiązkowy język wewnętrzny—wyzwanie wobec rankingu TOEFL 2010, gdzie Japonia zajęła przedostatnie miejsce w Azji Wschodniej, wyprzedzając jedynie Laos. Prezes Hondy Takanobu Ito publicznie krytykował: 'To nierozsądne, by japońskie firmy używały wyłącznie angielskiego w kraju.' Mikitani odpowiada: 'Nasz biznes internetowy różni się od produkcji Hondy. Globalny sukces wymaga internacjonalizacji centrali.' Mimo japońskich problemów gospodarczych, Rakuten rozwija się globalnie—tworzy chiński oddział i przejmuje firmy w USA oraz Francji. Mikitani argumentuje: 'Granice państw i waluty stracą znaczenie w globalnej rywalizacji.' Krytykuje też postawę młodych: 'Młodzi wolą stabilność niż ambicje. Potrzebujemy odważniejszych, międzynarodowych strategii.' Mikitani podkreśla: 'Choć czas na zmiany się kurczy, Rakuten—co znaczy optymizm—wyznacza drogę przez cyfryzację i reformy gospodarcze.'

article_content: QUINCY, Massachusetts – Warren Lewis, former Boston College Eagles hockey champion, now leads the Quincy Bald Eagles at age 80. This senior hockey team meets three times weekly at Quincy Youth Arena near Boston, with players ranging from their 50s to 80s. 'You never get in the game unless you intend to win it,' Lewis remarks, though he acknowledges their version is 'slow-motion hockey.' Founded 16 years ago by Bill 'Bibby' Lewis, the group has grown from 5 to 60 members. Five octogenarians and 23 septuagenarians regularly compete in non-checking matches where physical contact is accidental at most. 'If one of us falls,' jokes Wayne Gauthier, 'it takes two or three to help up.' Players cite multiple motivations: Brian Caputo (73) seeks to 'stay young,' while John Cusik values health as 'wealth.' Despite arthritis and knee issues limiting some participation, members emphasize social benefits. Dick Lyons notes the team provides 'camaraderie' missing from retirement, and Jack Buonopane prefers it to 'daytime television.' The Bald Eagles occasionally compete in national senior tournaments but focus primarily on weekly friendly matches. As Bibby Lewis summarizes: 'We come back for more as long as we can.' Post-game interactions feature good-natured banter and universal satisfaction, with Warren Lewis concluding: 'You can't get a better game than that.'

article_content: Genetic evidence confirms bats as the evolutionary source of bed bugs, according to University of Tulsa researchers. Published findings in BBC coverage detail analysis of Cimex lectularius specimens from 13 nations, revealing how ancient human-bat cohabitation in Eurasian caves enabled host switching. The study identifies two genetically distinct European lineages nearing speciation status. Complementing this, Sheffield University's 2014 research demonstrated that a single gravid bed bug can establish infestations through rapid reproduction. This reproductive efficiency, combined with increasing insecticide resistance and global travel patterns, explains modern resurgence. Historical records show infestation rates decreased from 75% of households in the late 19th century to 25% post-WWII before recent rebounds. While not disease carriers, bed bug bites cause varied skin reactions. Extermination expert David Cain notes their spread through transported belongings, emphasizing their persistence in human environments. The species' wingless nature and preference for exposed skin areas make them particularly adept at coexisting with humans.

Wykryto dwie genetycznie odrębne linie w Europie, bliskie uznania za osobne gatunki. Uzupełniające badania z Uniwersytetu w Sheffield z 2014 roku udowodniły, że już jedna ciężarna samica pluskwy może zapoczątkować plagę dzięki ekspresowemu rozmnażaniu. article_content: Iranian opposition figure Mir Hossein Moussavi has sharply criticized current leadership, asserting that authoritarian practices from the pre-revolutionary Shah era persist under today's Islamic Republic. Speaking via his website, the former prime minister stated: 'What we're witnessing now proves the revolution didn't eradicate dictatorship - it merely rebranded it under religious pretexts.' The remarks come during heightened tensions surrounding February 11 anniversary commemorations of the 1979 revolution. Authorities recently confirmed plans to execute nine individuals tied to post-election demonstrations, following two hangings last week. Over 4,000 detainees remain in custody since June's disputed presidential vote that kept Mahmoud Ahmadinejad in power. Moussavi, whose nephew died in December's Ashura holy day protests, condemned the 'systematic suppression' including media censorship and judicial abuses. While endorsing peaceful dissent, he warned that unlawful actions could undermine reform efforts. The Green Movement he supports emphasizes civil liberties and inclusive governance, contrasting with pro-government rallies featuring chants against opposition leaders. Parliamentary calls for Moussavi's arrest intensify as security forces balance crackdowns with fears of escalating unrest. The reformist leader maintains his readiness for 'martyrdom' amid threats, according to social media posts.

article_content: Gordon Ramsay will end his 12-year partnership with London's Claridge's Hotel in June following unsuccessful contract renewal negotiations. The celebrity chef withdrew from discussions after delays in finalizing terms, marking the conclusion of an era that began in 2001 through his initial collaboration with Chris Hutcheson, his former business partner and ex-father-in-law. The venue's culinary standing diminished over time, losing its Michelin star in 2010 and receiving critical assessments in industry guides. Harden's 2013 London rankings positioned it as the city's second 'most disappointing' dining experience and fourth 'most overpriced'. Ramsay cited simplified menus for economic accessibility during financial crises as a factor, while patrons questioned his divided focus between media projects and international expansions. This closure continues a trend of Ramsay's restaurant contractions since 2008, with venues closing across four continents. Financial challenges peaked in 2009 with near-bankruptcy protection filings, prompting asset sales including his Prague and Hollywood establishments. The Claridge's exit follows Ramsay's 2012 £2 million settlement with Hutcheson, resolving legal disputes over business practices and ownership stakes. Hotel management acknowledged Ramsay's contributions while signaling new culinary directions. Industry analysts view this transition as part of the chef's evolving career landscape, balancing premium dining, television fame, and consumer product ventures amidst ongoing operational challenges.

article_content: By Jenny Hope | Updated 20:32 EST, 12 February 2013 Researchers warn lung cancer deaths among British women now surpass breast cancer fatalities and will continue rising through the decade, linked to historical smoking patterns. While overall cancer mortality rates decline in Europe, lung cancer remains the UK's leading cancer killer with the continent's highest incidence rate. New data projects 1.3 million European cancer deaths for 2013 across 27 nations, reflecting a 6% decrease for men and 4% for women since 2009. Experts attribute improved treatments for reduced mortality across most cancers, except female lung cancer cases tied to delayed smoking adoption patterns. In the UK, lung cancer claims nearly 16,000 women's lives annually compared to 12,000 breast cancer deaths. The Annals of Oncology study reports a 7% rise in European female lung cancer mortality since 2009. Professor Carlo La Vecchia of Milan University notes: 'Lung cancer will become Europe's leading female cancer killer by 2015, already evident in high-rate countries like the UK (21.2 per 100,000) and Poland (17.5 per 100,000). This trend reflects 1960s-1970s smoking uptake among women. However, reduced smoking rates suggest potential stabilization post-2020 at approximately 15 per 100,000.' Breast cancer deaths show steady decline with 7% reduction EU-wide since 2009. Male lung cancer remains predominant but decreasing (6% drop since 2009 to 37.2 per 100,000). Dr. Penny Woods of the British Lung Foundation advocates intensified tobacco controls: 'Preventing prolonged high mortality requires measures like standardized packaging and sales bans.' Breakthrough Breast Cancer's Sally Greenbrook cautions against complacency despite progress: 'Continued research investment remains crucial for prevention and treatment.'

W Wielkiej Brytanii rak płuca powoduje blisko 16 000 zgonów kobiet rocznie, w porównaniu do 12 000 zgonów z powodu raka piersi. Badanie opublikowane w Annals of Oncology odnotowuje 7% wzrost śmiertelności z powodu raka płuca wśród europejskich kobiet od 2009 roku. Prof. Carlo La Vecchia z Uniwersytetu w Mediolanie komentuje: 'Rak płuca stanie się wiodącą przyczyną zgonów nowotworowych wśród kobiet w Europie do 2015 roku, co jest już widoczne w krajach o najwyższych wskaźnikach, takich jak Wielka Brytania (21,2 na 100 000) i Polska (17,5 na 100 000). Trend ten odzwierciedla wzrost palenia wśród kobiet w latach 60. i 70. XX wieku. Jednak obecnie mniejsza liczba młodych kobiet w UK i innych częściach Europy zaczyna palić, co może oznaczać stabilizację śmiertelności po 2020 roku na poziomie około 15 na 100 000.' Śmiertelność z powodu raka piersi systematycznie spada, z 7% redukcją w UE od 2009 roku. Rak płuca pozostaje główną przyczyną zgonów nowotworowych u mężczyzn (187 000 przewidywanych zgonów w 2013 roku, 37,2 na 100 000), ale odnotowano 6% spadek od 2009 roku. Dr Penny Woods, dyrektor British Lung Foundation, stwierdza: 'Prognoza, że rak płuca wyprzedzi raka piersi jako główną przyczynę zgonów wśród europejskich kobiet, budzi poważne obawy. Aby uniknąć utrzymywania się takich statystyk w XXI wieku, konieczne są dalsze działania kontrolne jak standaryzowane opakowania papierosów i zakaz sprzedaży w punktach detalicznych.' Sally Greenbrook z Breakthrough Breast Cancer dodaje: 'Spadek śmiertelności raka piersi w Europie to dobra wiadomość, ale nie możemy popadać w samozadowolenie. Konieczne są dalsze badania nad profilaktyką i terapią tych chorób.'

article_content: Former Virginia Governor Bob McDonnell faced challenges managing his wife's unpredictable conduct during his administration, according to defense testimony in their ongoing corruption trial. As prosecutors concluded nearly three weeks of evidence presentation, McDonnell's legal team introduced accounts suggesting Maureen McDonnell's temperament caused significant staff disruptions, nearly prompting mass resignations at the governor's residence. The corruption case centers on allegations that the couple accepted over $165,000 in gifts and loans from Jonnie Williams, former CEO of Star Scientific Inc., allegedly in exchange for promoting the company's Anatabloc supplements. Defense witnesses described Maureen McDonnell as frequently confrontational, with former administration official Janet Kelly testifying about ongoing difficulties managing the former first lady's 'pathologically irresponsible' behavior. Kelly, who served as Secretary of the Commonwealth, recounted having limited direct interaction with Maureen McDonnell despite her official role. 'I didn't want to contribute to negative perceptions unnecessarily,' Kelly stated emotionally during testimony. She revealed staff members collectively protested against what they deemed unacceptable treatment, drafting a letter comparing their experiences to 'being scolded like misbehaving children.' The defense highlighted marital tensions between the McDonnells, including testimony about Maureen's alleged romantic interest in Williams. Lawyers suggested the couple's strained relationship prevented coordinated illegal activities. article_content: In Los Angeles, filmmaker McG channeled his Michigan childhood fascination with mechanics into 'Terminator Salvation.' The director, who once played with toy robots, now orchestrated explosions with full-scale machines for the sci-fi sequel. Cast members revealed that a significant portion of the film's robotic elements were practical effects, honoring visual effects legend Stan Winston who passed during pre-production. 'Modern viewers intuitively sense authenticity,' noted Bryce Dallas Howard. 'While CGI remains crucial, physical props create gut-level responses.' The team built operational robotic units for actor interaction, with pyrotechnics sometimes proving too realistic - multiple crew members temporarily lost facial hair during controlled detonations. Christian Bale recounted the peculiar dynamic of performing alongside mechanized co-stars: 'Technicians manipulated these massive constructs via remote systems. Staying in character required intense concentration.' Anton Yelchin developed such admiration for the robots that he humorously requested to adopt one, though production regulations prevented it. McG stressed this hands-on methodology extended Winston's legacy of merging practical and digital effects. The Oscar-winning designer, involved in prior Terminator projects, had consulted early in the film's development. By integrating physical robots with CGI augmentation, the creators pursued what they termed 'tangible futurism' - advanced technology made immediately present through physical interaction.

article_content: A dense aggregation of jellyfish prompted emergency protocols at Sweden's Oskarshamn nuclear facility this week. Operator OKG manually disabled the plant's primary reactor when marine organisms obstructed critical cooling water intakes. This preventive action averted potential automatic shutdowns caused by insufficient thermal regulation. Plant authorities restored operations by Wednesday following installation of reinforced filtration mechanisms. While the seawater system doesn't directly cool nuclear components, it's essential for condensing process steam. The Baltic coast installation, operational since 1972, generates 10% of Sweden's electrical supply. This incident continues a documented pattern of jellyfish-related disruptions at coastal power stations worldwide, with over 20 similar cases reported since 1999 across multiple continents.

article_content: London (CNN) – Former UK Prime Minister Gordon Brown, a vocal critic of media mogul Rupert Murdoch, is scheduled to testify Monday at the Leveson Inquiry. This judicial investigation, established by the British government, examines media ethics following the News of the World phone-hacking scandal that led to the tabloid's closure in July 2011. The inquiry has already heard testimony from former Prime Minister Tony Blair and Murdoch himself, who claimed Brown threatened to 'declare war' on News Corp after one of its tabloids withdrew support for Labour. Prime Minister David Cameron, facing scrutiny over his connections to Murdoch and former News International CEO Rebekah Brooks, will testify Thursday. Chancellor George Osborne and former PM Gordon Brown appear Monday, followed by ex-PM John Major and Labour leader Ed Miliband on Tuesday. Deputy PM Nick Clegg testifies Wednesday before Scottish First Minister Alex Salmond. The Leveson Inquiry, initiated after public outrage over hacking victim Milly Dowler's voicemail, explores media-political relationships and press ethics. Blair acknowledged experiencing 'political pressure' from Murdoch but denied excessive closeness. Cameron admitted Parliament had overly 'cozied up' to Murdoch. Controversy surrounds Cameron's hiring of former News of the World editor Andy Coulson, who resigned amid renewed hacking investigations. Coulson now faces perjury charges. The BSkyB acquisition attempt collapsed during the scandal, which also revealed Brooks' frequent pre-election contacts with Cameron. The inquiry runs parallel to police investigations into hacking, email breaches, and alleged bribery involving Murdoch's UK outlets. News of the World closed permanently in July 2011 following multiple hacking revelations.

article_content: Sanford police arrested seven men Thursday during an undercover prostitution sting operation. A decoy officer was approached by suspects offering $3 and chicken dinners in exchange for sexual acts. Steven Torres, 32, of Melbourne allegedly made the proposition while accompanied by six other individuals. Police Chief Cecil Smith emphasized the department's dual focus: 'Our operations target both sex workers and those who solicit them to improve community wellbeing.' Those arrested include Ronald Barker (67), Christopher Butler (34), Tarance Carr (45), Troy Cuff (38), Thomas Ham (57), Antonio Perez Toma (36), and Steven Torres (32). All face charges of soliciting prostitution under Florida law.

article_content: Nearly 2,000 women treated in NHS hospitals in England were reported as FGM victims since April 2023. A landmark report reveals hundreds of FGM cases recorded monthly. English hospitals began mandatory FGM case reporting this April. The Health and Social Care Information Centre's first statistical release shows 1,746 identified cases over six months, including 467 new cases in September. This follows 1,279 previously recorded cases. Experts warn these figures may represent only the 'tip of the iceberg' for this hidden crime. NSPCC described the statistics as 'shocking'. John Cameron, Head of Child Protection Operations, stated: 'This NHS data confirms FGM as an ongoing public health crisis. Health professionals need training to identify signs and ensure victims receive post-traumatic support. Interagency cooperation is crucial to protect at-risk family members. Contact our helpline at 0800 028 3550 for concerns about vulnerable individuals.' Theresa May cited research estimating over 100,000 UK women live with FGM consequences, with 60,000 at risk. A City University London study estimates 10,000 under-15 migrants in England and Wales likely underwent FGM. The government's £1.4 million prevention program aims to eliminate FGM within a generation through legal measures (including parental prosecution), data collection, and professional training. FGM involves partial or total genital removal, often without anesthesia. Severe forms include vaginal closure complications requiring subsequent surgical openings. Health consequences range from chronic pain to fatal bleeding. Despite being illegal in the UK for 30 years, no convictions have occurred. The first trial involving two alleged perpetrators is set for January 2024. HSCIC's Kingsley Manning emphasized: 'This first national NHS dataset is crucial for prevention efforts. We'll expand data collection across care settings to support the Department of Health's FGM program.'

article_content: Yale University has unveiled comprehensive reforms following a federal investigation into its handling of sexual harassment cases. President Richard Levin confirmed Friday that the institution will establish an independent advisory panel and initiate campus-wide dialogues to improve compliance with Title IX regulations. This comes after federal officials alleged Yale's current processes may have denied students equal educational opportunities. The newly formed external committee, led by former Massachusetts Supreme Court Chief Justice Margaret Marshall, will gather community input and propose reforms by next fall. Additional members include former U.S. Solicitor General Seth Waxman and University of Chicago Dean of Students Kimberly Goff-Crews. Parallel to this effort, an internal working group comprising faculty and students will begin reviewing harassment policies starting July 1. These developments follow multiple controversies, including a 2010 viral video showing Delta Kappa Epsilon fraternity members chanting offensive slogans and reports of inappropriate campus events. While not addressing specific incidents, Levin emphasized Yale's commitment to fostering safer environments through both formal structures and informal discussions. Senior administrators will host casual conversations in dining halls this month, facilitated by the Women's Center, to gather student perspectives.

Decyzja zapadła po zarzutach federalnych urzędników, że dotychczasowe procedury Yale mogły ograniczać studentom równy dostęp do edukacji. Nowo powołany zewnętrzny komitet pod przewodnictwem byłej szefowej Sądu Najwyższego stanu Massachusetts Margaret Marshall będzie zbierał opinie społeczności akademickiej i przedstawi propozycje reform do przyszłej jesieni. article_content: Chinese authorities have prosecuted five individuals, including a medical professional, for their involvement in an unlawful organ extraction from a minor. The 2011 case involves a 17-year-old student from Anhui Province who received $3,500 for his kidney, funds partially used to purchase electronic devices. The lead surgeon reportedly profited nearly tenfold from the transaction. Medical reports indicate the adolescent donor now experiences progressive renal insufficiency following the unauthorized procedure. Key defendant He Wei, described as financially desperate due to gambling debts, allegedly organized the operation through digital communication channels. Provincial hospital surgeon Song Zhongyu received approximately $35,000 for performing the illicit transplant. China's health authorities report a critical shortage of organ donations, with annual transplant operations meeting less than 1% of national demand. The case came to light when the minor confessed to his mother about the source of his sudden income after she questioned his acquisition of expensive technology products.

article_content: Lewis Hamilton has publicly addressed recent tensions with Mercedes teammate Nico Rosberg through social media, though the timing drew scrutiny. On Friday afternoon, Hamilton tweeted: 'Our friendship has endured many phases. Following today's conversation, we remain friends moving forward.' This followed Mercedes' earlier statement that Hamilton was traveling to Canada for the June 8 Grand Prix. The social media post coincided with Sky Sports' announcement of a planned segment analyzing the drivers' rivalry, intensified by Rosberg's controversial pole position in Monaco. Hamilton had previously implied Rosberg deliberately triggered yellow flags during qualifying. Sky's 4:22pm tweet soliciting fan engagement preceded Hamilton's message by 11 minutes, occurring shortly after media inquiries about their communication status. Mercedes confirmed Hamilton independently shared a childhood photo of the pair cycling, stating it reflected their current dynamic. While emphasizing their professional relationship continues, the team acknowledged social media's complex role in both managing and complicating public narratives.

W piątek po południu Hamilton napisał na Twitterze: 'Nasza przyjaźń przetrwała różne etapy. Po dzisiejszej rozmowie nadal jesteśmy przyjaciółmi.' Tweet pojawił się po informacji Mercedes, że Hamilton leciał już do Kanady na Grand Prix zaplanowane na 8 czerwca. Publikacja zbiegła się z zapowiedzią Sky Sports dotyczącą analizy rywalizacji kierowców, która zaostrzyła się po kontrowersyjnym zdobyciu przez Rosberga pierwszej pozycji w kwalifikacjach w Monako. Hamilton wcześniej twierdził, że Rosberg celowo sprowokował żółte flagi podczas jego ostatniego okrążenia. Tweet Sky z 16:22 z prośbą o opinie fanów poprzedził wpis Hamiltona o 11 minut, publikowany tuż po dziennikarskich pytaniach o ich relację. Mercedes potwierdził, że Hamilton samodzielnie opublikował dziecięce zdjęcie z Rosbergiem na rowerach, co miało odzwierciedlać aktualną sytuację. Podkreślając utrzymanie profesjonalnej współpracy, zespół przyznał, że media społecznościowe pełnią złożoną rolę w kształtowaniu opinii publicznej.

article_content: The Marysville school shooting has claimed its fourth young victim as 15-year-old Andrew Fryberg succumbed to injuries sustained in the October 24 attack. Andrew had fought to survive for 15 days after being shot point-blank in the head by his cousin Jaylen Fryberg during the cafeteria incident at Marysville-Pilchuck High School. The tragedy's final toll now stands at five fatalities, including the shooter who took his own life, with 14-year-old Nate Hatch remaining as the sole survivor after being upgraded to serious condition on October 28. Initial victims included Andrew's girlfriend Zoe Galasso, who died immediately at the scene. Gia Soriano and Shaylee Chuckulnaskit, both 14, passed away days later in hospital. The Fryberg family released an emotional statement from Harborview Medical Center praising medical staff and community support while requesting privacy during their grief. All involved teenagers belonged to the Tulalip Tribe, a significant Native American community near Seattle. Nate Hatch, who sustained a jaw wound rather than head trauma, continues recovering at Harborview. Investigators revealed Jaylen coordinated the attack by texting friends to gather at a cafeteria table during an early lunch period, days after returning from a football-related suspension. While motives remain unclear, social media posts suggest escalating tensions prior to the violence.

article_content: Nottingham Forest has parted ways with manager Stuart Pearce following a 1-0 home defeat at City Ground to Championship side Millwall, marking their third win in 23 matches. Owner Fawaz Al Hasawi confirmed Pearce's departure after Sunday discussions, ending the club legend's seven-month tenure. Former Chelsea defender Dan Petrescu, with experience managing in Romania, Poland, and Russia, is now the frontrunner to become Forest's fifth manager since Al Hasawi's 2012 takeover. Pressure had mounted on Pearce following a 31.3% win rate (10 victories in 32 matches) and recent poor performances. Despite a crucial Derby County win temporarily easing pressure, subsequent losses to Fulham and Millwall proved decisive. The club's official statement noted Al Hasawi offered Pearce an advisory role, which remains under consideration. Al Hasawi stated: 'This was my toughest football decision. While results necessitated change, Stuart's legacy remains respected. I hope he accepts an ongoing role to help us move forward.' Petrescu now prepares for talks about revitalizing Forest's season.

Były obrońca Chelsea Dan Petrescu, z doświadczeniem szkoleniowym w Rumunii, Polsce i Rosji, jest teraz głównym kandydatem na piątego szkoleniowca za kadencji Al Hasawiego (od 2012). article_content: When Catherine Dawes celebrated her 50th birthday with a long-awaited pet pig purchase, she anticipated caring for a compact companion. The Blantyre resident invested £500 in what was marketed as a micro-pig, expecting an animal smaller than most dogs. Three years later, Dudley the pig measures 5ft 8in from snout to tail and weighs over 20 stone - far exceeding initial promises. The journey began when Dawes and partner Colin traveled to Nottingham after a breeder's assurance of providing suitable miniature swine. 'I've adored pigs since childhood and finally thought I'd found the perfect solution,' Dawes recalled. 'We envisioned him living indoors like any family dog.' Despite being house-trained and TV-loving, Dudley's growth soon revealed the truth. Micro-pigs typically reach 2 stone fully grown, but Dudley kept expanding. 'We first noticed when he reached coffee-table height,' Dawes explained. 'Now he stands up to my waist and recently bruised my foot during an accidental step.' Attempts to contact the breeder proved futile, though Dawes admits attachment prevented any reconsideration. The 280-pound porker now divides his time between indoor lounging and nights in a customized garden shed with straw bedding and heating lamps. While family dog Dexter sometimes feels overshadowed, Dudley charms visitors with banana-fueled antics and door-closing tricks. Community reactions range from bewilderment to delight, with passing drivers once causing near-accidents while gawking. 'People bring bananas hoping to meet him,' Dawes laughed. 'We just watch our shoelaces - he thinks they're chew toys!' Despite the unexpected journey, she concludes: 'He's our gentle giant now.'

Mitchell draws parallels to the Wall Street bailout's negative consequences, including moral hazard, cautioning against expanding government intervention in markets.

article_content: Gareen imaltootaa baddaa Iskootilaandi miseensota torba ofkeessaa qabu Kaaba-Lixa biyyattii keessa osoo deemanii bakakkaan rukutee dubarti ganna 55 tokko ajjeessuun namoota waliin turan madeesse. Akka poolisiin iddoo balaan kun itti uumamee ibsetti, namoonni daawwannaaf imalarra jiran kun Sanbata darbe naannoo 'Na Gruagaichean' jedhamu kan tulluu Ben Nevis dhiyoo ture. Namoonni balaa bakakkaa kanaan madaa'an hunduu xiyyaaraan gara hospitaala dhiyeenya isaaniitti argamu kan geeffaman yoo ta'u, dubartiin umurii waggaa 55 garuu du'uu ishee gabaaseera poolisiin. Maatiin dubartii duutee kanaas dhaga'aniiru. Bakakkaan tibba roobaa bakka gara garaatti qaqqaba. Balaan kun lubbuu namaafi horii akkasumas qabeenyarra miidhaa geessisuu danda'a. Bakakaa ykn qaqawwee ilaalchisee yaadawwan gara garaatu jiru. Namoonni dheekkamsa Rabbiidha jedhan akkuma jiran kanneen ija saayinsawaan ilaalan ammoo sababii itti uumamuuf himu. Aadaa tokko tokko keessatti yoo namni bakakkaadhaan du'e hin boo'an, yoo horiin bakakkaadhaan dhmes hin gaddan. 'Isaafuu xinnaadha' jedhu malee. Kana malees bakakkaan/qaqqawween yeroo hedduu waan hunda caalaa ol-dheeraa ta'e rukkuta kan jedhanii amananis jiru. Akkasumallee, bakakkaan bakka takkaa rukkute si'a lamaffaa hin rukkutu jedhu. Garuu ija saayinsiitiin kun dhugaa miti. Bakakkaan/qaqawween ji'oota o'a qabuufi duumessi jabaa gurraacha'ee uumamudha. Kan uumamus yeroo lafa irraa qilleensi o'aan ol ba'ee qilleensa qorraa duumessa keessa jirutti bu'udha jedhu qorattoonni. Bakakkaafi ballaqqeen isaa elektiriika duumessa keessa deemuu, duumessa irraa ammoo qilleensatti ykn duumessa irraa gara lafaatti deemudha. Bakkaan yeroo hedduu kan qaqqawwisaa turu yeroo walakkaa saatii hin caalleefidha. Balaqqeen bakakkaa dheeraan isaas gababaan isaas nama ajjeesuu danda'a. Balaqqeen bakakkaa yeroo lafa ga'u humna elektirikaa 20,000-30,000 amps ta'e qabatee bu'a. Kana jechuun ammoo humna elektiriikaa maashina itti uffata miicaniif fayyadaman harka 2,300 (akkasumas ampaarii 15-200) caala jechuudha. Namoonni yeroo hedduu bakakkaadhaaf saaxilamanis warra ala jirani, qonnaa, tika, bakkeewwan gaaraarra jirani fa'aati. Namoonni baay'een yeroo nagaadha jedhanittillee bakakkaan rukutamuu danda'u. Bakakkaan darbeera jedhanii yaaduun of dagatu.
